description: Create the React/TypeScript frontend (Local Web Dashboard) with all required pages: Dashboard overview, AIBox device monitoring, Camera monitoring, Event timeline, Event detail, Ack/Memo functionality, and CSV/Excel report export. The frontend connects to the gateway REST API and SignalR hub for real-time updates.
steps: Initialize React project with Vite in web/ directory: npm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts

Install dependencies: @microsoft/signalr (SignalR client), react-router-dom (routing), axios (HTTP client), dayjs (date formatting), @tanstack/react-query (data fetching), lucide-react (icons), tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite (styling)
Configure Vite in web/vite.config.ts with: proxy /api and /hubs to http://localhost:8088 for development, build output to ../gateway/src/wwwroot/ for production integration
Configure Tailwind CSS with tailwind.config.js and add to main CSS file
Create app layout in web/src/App.tsx with: React Router setup, sidebar navigation (Dashboard, AIBox Devices, Cameras, Events, Reports), main content area, header with connection status indicator
Create web/src/services/api.ts with axios instance configured for /api base URL, typed request/response interfaces matching all gateway endpoints
Create web/src/services/signalr.ts with SignalR hub connection to /hubs/events, auto-reconnect logic, event handlers for NewEvent, DeviceStatusChanged, CameraStatusChanged

Create web/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: summary cards (total devices, online devices, total cameras, online cameras, unconfirmed events, today's events), recent events list (last 10), device status overview grid

Create web/src/pages/Devices.tsx: device list table with status indicators (online=green, offline=red, warning=yellow), add device form/modal (all registration fields), edit device, delete device with confirmation

Create web/src/pages/Cameras.tsx: camera list table with status indicators, grouped by device, add camera form/modal (all registration fields including RTSP URL, ONVIF settings), edit camera, delete camera

Create web/src/pages/Events.tsx: event timeline/list with: filters (date range, device, camera, event type, severity, ack status), sortable columns, pagination, severity color coding (HIGH=red, MEDIUM=orange, LOW=blue), real-time new event insertion via SignalR, click to view detail

Create web/src/pages/EventDetail.tsx: full event detail view showing all normalized event fields, snapshot image display (if snapshot_url available), acknowledge button (changes ack_status to confirmed, records ack_user and ack_time), action memo text area with save button, raw payload JSON viewer
Create web/src/pages/Reports.tsx: date range selector, filter options (device, event type, severity), export to CSV button that calls GET /api/events/export/csv, download handling

Create shared components in web/src/components/: StatusBadge.tsx (colored badges for device/camera/event status), SeverityBadge.tsx (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW with colors), EventCard.tsx (compact event display for lists), Pagination.tsx, Modal.tsx, LoadingSpinner.tsx, EmptyState.tsx
Create web/src/hooks/useSignalR.ts custom hook for managing SignalR connection lifecycle and event subscriptions
Add proper TypeScript interfaces in web/src/types/ matching all backend models: Device, Camera, NormalizedEvent, DashboardSummary, PaginatedResponse
Configure build script in package.json to output to ../gateway/src/wwwroot/
Run 'npm run build' to verify frontend builds without errors
Create web/README.md documenting the frontend architecture, development setup, and build instructions
acceptance_criteria: Running 'npm run build' in web/ directory completes without errors
Build output is configured to go to ../gateway/src/wwwroot/
All pages render: Dashboard, Devices, Cameras, Events, EventDetail, Reports
SignalR client is configured to connect to /hubs/events
REST API client has typed methods for all gateway endpoints
Event list supports filtering by date range, device, event type, severity, ack status
Event detail page has acknowledge button and action memo input
Reports page has CSV export functionality
verification: Run 'npm install' in web/ directory and confirm exit code 0
Run 'npm run build' in web/ directory and confirm exit code 0 with output in dist/ or ../gateway/src/wwwroot/
